text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hey, look at this! My buddies made my 
castle in an app for me!! Coooooool!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
The first floor is naturally a dance hall 
where everyone can dance! Plus an arcade 
and pool you can enjoy all day, and a bar 
lounge on the rooftop!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Still, this is a prototype! There's room 
for improvement by incorporating feedback 
from the residents.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
What do you want in this castle? Don't 
hold back, just let me know!
